title: Temporary Personnel Services
agency_path: City of New York > Information Technology and Telecommunications
description_text:
The Office of Innovation and Technology (OTI), on behalf of the Mayor's Office of Media and Entertainment (MOME or the Agency), is seeking an appropriately qualified vendor (Contractor) to provide temporary personnel services as requested by MOME on an as-needed basis.

This solicitation is released through PASSPort, New York Citys online procurement portal, as an RFx. Responses to this solicitation must be submitted via PASSPort.
To reach the Public Portal, visit the following site: https://www.nyc.gov/site/mocs/passport/about-passport.page then click on the rectangle captioned Procurement Navigator, whereupon you will arrive at the Portal.

Please visit https://passport.cityofnewyork.us/page.aspx/en/rfp/request_browse_public and search by EPIN 85827B0001 to view all information and the documents of this solicitation.

All questions or inquiries regarding this solicitation must be submitted in the PASSPort Discussion Forum.
